datePolicy: Research and all cited-source access dates are recorded as 2026-11-06 in retained sources.md and housing/insurance-tax narratives. ECB observation is 2026-11-05 and Atlas rate effective date is 2025-05-29. Unknown publication/update dates remain unknown; search-extract access is not relabelled as full-page retrieval. English authoring on 2026-11-06 did not refresh any rule, price, policy or source, and is not a publication date.
uncertainties: Not immigration, tax, legal or insurance advice. Employer permission, personal eligibility, legal employing entity, Japanese PE/salary-cost bearing, treaty residence, prior Japan visits, US state/county and medical history remain unresolved.

Six months is not automatically 183 treaty days. Inclusive calendar examples do not establish authoritative arrival/departure counting; other visits inside the rolling period matter. Actual landing permission controls immigration expiry. No FEIE assumed for this trip alone.

US state is unknown, so mission selection and state-tax consequences are unresolved. SF February 2026 mail, insurance, fee, visa-validity and processing details are examples, not nationwide or 2027 guarantees. Four-to-eight weeks is an author planning buffer.

Jurisdiction, consulate-guide and Miami visitor information rests on official search extracts because direct retrieval was denied; no full-page read is claimed. MOFA text was obtained after automatic managed-browser fallback and corroborated with ISA/SF evidence.

Original research's clean-session constraint was not perfectly met: MOFA, fukuokarent.com and SSA fetches automatically fell back to an existing managed browser whose clean state was uncertified. Fukuoka error and SSA fallback content were excluded; included housing was independently re-fetched by unauthenticated raw HTTP; IRS/JPS support payroll discussion. No external retrieval occurred during this authoring task.

Both insurers are screened candidates, not government-approved or personally accepted cover. Atlas price uses a 2025 rate sheet; SafetyWing exact-date billing and issued 2027 version are unquoted. Mixed-version FAQ and incomplete older specimen do not establish a current contract. Full-term documentation, independent cover/AD&D where required, exclusions, chronic/routine care and medical needs must be confirmed.

Eight housing observations are not eight vacant homes. T2, F3 and F4 were full/occupied. No April 2027 price, availability or unconditional digital-nomad acceptance confirmed. Oakhouse passport pathway is conditional; JapanHeya is intermediary/channel marketing; Fukuoka sharehouse no-card eligibility unresolved. Unknown costs are not zero and refundable deposits are not expenses.

Sharely portal and operator rents are distinct, not additive; utility/bedclothes exclusions, inconsistent duration endpoints and short-stay cleaning treatment remain unresolved. No speed test, US-hours noise assessment or workspace/security suitability is established for any home.

Budget is six full monthly bills despite the 174-day sample. Housing targets and other unquoted allowances are planning choices. Income/payroll taxes, US recurring obligations, debts, major shopping and extensive travel are excluded; salary is gross. Japanese nonresident tax baseline is not an assessed liability. FX is dated, not a forecast or consular conversion mandate.

English only for the US remote tester profile; no bilingual parity claim. Only new English Markdown and matching semantic JSON authored. No shared inventory, build, manifest, HTML, source-run or website edit; no publication, application, booking, purchase, contact, account or external research. Local source-list/evidence locators follow existing stage2-relative renderer convention, not public download promises. Original run model unknown.
